SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., Aug. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cornerstone Advisors ("Cornerstone"), a leading management and technology consultancy serving banks, credit unions, and fintechs, today announced the appointment of Mazen Ghalayini as Chief Executive Officer and Chairman. Ghalayini succeeds Cornerstone CEO and co-founder Steve Williams, who is transitioning to Founding Partner, effective immediately. ... Moving from his position as President, in his new role as CEO Ghalayini will lead the firm's strategic direction, operations and continued investment in delivering advisory services, research, and technology insights to financial institutions navigating a rapidly evolving industry, providing the client-centric culture that has defined Cornerstone for more ... two decades.

hits.snippet: Cornerstone Advisors Appoints Steve Williams as CEO ... # Cornerstone Advisors Appoints Steve Williams as CEO ... May 17, 2024 ... Williams succeeds Scott Sommer, who will assume the role of board chairman and drive the company’s M&A strategy. ... Scottsdale, Ariz., May 17, 2024 – Cornerstone Advisors, a leading management and technology consultancy for banks, credit unions, and fintech firms, announced today that Steve Williams, the company’s long-standing president, has been appointed chief executive officer. Williams succeeds Scott Sommer, who co-founded Cornerstone with Williams and others in 2002 and will now serve as Cornerstone’s chairman of the board.

hits.snippet: SCOTTSDALE, Ariz. – August 04, 2026 – On the surface, the announcement from Cornerstone Advisors is a standard C-suite shuffle: a celebrated founder steps aside for a new leader to take the helm. But to read the transition of Steve Williams to Founding Partner and the appointment of Mazen Ghalayini as CEO and Chairman as a simple succession is to miss the quiet strategic masterstroke at play. In a move that speaks volumes about the firm's foresight, Cornerstone isn't just changing its leader; it's recalibrating its entire strategic engine for the next decade of financial disruption. ... Enter Mazen Ghalayini, the new CEO and Chairman. His ascent from President is the other half of this strategic equation. Ghalayini is not a legacy hire; he is a specialist in transformation. With over 25 years of experience scaling professional and technology services organizations, particularly in private equity-backed environments, his resume reads like a blueprint for the modern consultancy. His background at firms like West Monroe Partners, where he led strategies in Customer Experience, Digital Product Development, and Artificial Intelligence, is telling.
